capabilities: Synchronize scrolling across two or more selected PDF panes, including popout windows
Align PDFs by matching page numbers and fractional positions or by overall scroll progress
Capture manual offsets after pausing, so differently paginated documents stay aligned
Select or reselect which visible PDF panes participate, beyond the automatic two-pane group
Pause or resume synchronization from the ribbon, status bar, or commands
disambiguation: Despite 'Sync' in the name, it synchronizes scrolling between PDF viewers, not file syncing across devices or text/translation alignment.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.14.4+, macOS verified; Windows/Linux untested, mobile excluded); relies on the built-in PDF viewer's non-stable DOM; supports only vertical continuous scrolling with no page spreads; other scroll-sync plugins must be disabled for the synced panes; no network requests or telemetry; community listing approval was pending at submission.
problem: Obsidian's PDF panes scroll independently, so reading or comparing several PDFs side by side requires manually keeping them at matching positions.
summary: Scrolls two or more selected PDF panes together, with page or progress alignment, manual offsets, and popout window support.
